description: Traveler mentors NØVA without finishing NØVA’s identity.
Traveler protects Kai’s right to keep asking.
NØVA offers older-sibling spark: try, then care.
Lyra teaches method so NØVA’s impulse can survive evidence.
Orion coaches Kai’s body without shutting down Kai’s questions.
Atlas walks builder and rescue paths beside Traveler.
Maya guides the group through living systems and labeled stories.
Echo helps everyone search and remember, without becoming an oracle.
Wavo plays in water with Kai and yields technique to Orion.
Wavo is not the swimming teacher of record.
